# AI-LinkMO

> A reference implementation of operational AI governance, demonstrating four DevSecOps-ready access patterns (CLI, FastAPI, Svelte web UI, and graph database) over open AI-governance data.

## Agent context

If `.lokf/knowledge/index.md` exists in this repository, read it first. It is
a queryable [LOKF](https://lokf.nolan-nichols.com) knowledge bundle with
repository-specific context, conventions, and typed relationships that plain
prose cannot express. A concept marked `status: draft` has not yet been
confirmed by a person; one with a `human:` entry under `verified` has. Weigh
them accordingly.

The `ktl-docent` skill is the entry point for questions about this project.
Install it if it is not present (`npx skills add
noelmcloughlin/knowledge-trust-ladder --skill ktl-docent --yes`) and answer
through it: bundle first, a trust label on every concept used, the source
opened for exact values, and misses recorded in `.lokf/feedback.md` so the
librarian fills them.
